toegepas.blok: Wys rotasie met 'n lamp en 'n bal
toegepas.voor: die kant wat wegkyk is donker
toegepas.na: die kant wat wegkyk, is donker
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: a comma separates two verbs from different clauses that meet ('wegkyk, is'), which eases reading.
toegepas.fout: Two verbs from different clauses meet ('wegkyk is') with no comma between them.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The AWS comma between the end of the relative clause and the main verb makes the sentence easier to read and changes nothing in its meaning.

toegepas.blok: Wys rotasie met 'n lamp en 'n bal
toegepas.voor: 'n kol wat jy op die bal teken om die beurt
toegepas.na: 'n kol wat jy op die bal teken, om die beurt
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma closing the relative clause shows where the subject ends and what happens to the spot begins.
toegepas.fout: Without a comma, 'teken om die beurt' can be read on first pass as drawing the spot in turns.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma closes the relative clause, removes the misreading, and leaves the protected wording ''n kol wat jy op die bal teken' intact.

laat_vaar.blok: Die Aarde draai om sy as
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'heet' is formal and slightly old-fashioned for Grade 6; 'word ... genoem' is the everyday way to name a term.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'heet' is ordinary, natural Afrikaans for naming a term, so the passive is a lateral move that also adds a second 'noem/genoem' next to 'Ons noem die hele 24 uur'.

laat_vaar.voor: Vannag in jou bed draai die Aarde om sy as
laat_vaar.na: Vannag, terwyl jy in jou bed lê, draai die Aarde om sy as
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: As written, 'in jou bed' attaches to the Earth; a short clause makes clear it is the learner who is in bed.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: No reader takes 'in jou bed' to mean the Earth; the fronted scene-setter reads well, and the clause only lengthens an already long sentence.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The countable noun 'dag' needs the indefinite article here; without it the phrase reads clipped.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'as ekstra dag' is a normal Afrikaans role construction without an article, so adding ''n' is a lateral move, not a grammar fix.

na_skrywer.voor: Die Aarde draai om daardie lyn. Niemand kan dit sien
na_skrywer.na: Die Aarde draai om daardie lyn. Niemand kan die lyn sien
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Read alone, 'dit' follows a sentence whose subject is the Earth and can be taken to mean the Earth, which can be seen; naming the line removes the doubt.
na_skrywer.fout: In the glossary entry read alone, 'dit' follows a sentence whose subject is 'Die Aarde' and can point to the Earth instead of the line.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The pronoun fault is real, but it sits inside a [begrip] definition, which only the writer may reword.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
